reasons.clip|span.truncate.text-[11px]: The Record header repeats the active dog/breed already present in the page header and identity section; ellipsis keeps its four working tools on one row. Complete text remains in the DOM and full identity record.
reasons.clip|p.truncate.text-[11px]: Breed/name summaries stay on one line in the compact record column; the breed is repeated in the page header. Full DOM text, tooltip and print record preserve the information.
reasons.clip|dd.min-w-0.truncate: Read-only identity cells keep compact comparison rows. Full values remain in their titles and DOM text, and actual PDF/JSON preservation tests prove complete data is available. No action label or source qualification is truncated.
reasons.clip|li.truncate.text-[11px]: Long descriptive marks/habits are single-line summaries in the fixed record. Each full sentence remains in its title and complete print/export; no working control is hidden.
reasons.clip|span.text-[10px].text-faint: The narrow Commons list keeps neighbor name, breed and action in a single comparison row. Only the long breed summary is ellipsized; its full value is in the title and button DOM/accessible text, while name and current action remain readable.
